axes.y_title: Year to date, year on year

footnote: Source: NBS monthly releases for Q1 (April 16), H1 (July 15) and August (September 15, 2026)
notes: Three points in time, to show the direction. Investment weakened most: fixed-asset investment grew 1.7% in the first quarter, fell 5.7% in the first half and 7.2% in January to August, with property development down 19.9% and private investment down 10.1%. Retail sales slowed from 2.4% to 1.1%, though retail sales of services grew 4.9% in January to August, faster than goods. Industrial output held above 5%. Prices are recovering: producer prices went from −0.6% in the first quarter to +2.0% for January to August, and +3.8% in August alone. Consumer prices are near 1%, still well short of the target of about 2%. Surveyed unemployment averaged 5.2%.
